text: shared-test-cases: category canon, price parsing and formatting have no shared table

Landed with T-274/T-275. Both new groups are driven by both suites and the web gained the non-empty-group guard Android already had. Money/date formatting was deliberately left without a shared table: the two clients use different locale engines (Intl vs java.text), whose output already differs by ICU/CLDR version within a platform, so an exact-string cross-engine table would be a flake generator rather than a drift guard. I agree with that call.
